pinyin: shān xī lǎo xiāng —— ài chī cù
literal: Shanxi · fellow native — love · eat · vinegar

meaning.en: Jealous (punning on 吃醋, 'to be jealous').
meaning.zh: 山西人爱吃醋，借“吃醋”双关嫉妒。

examples.zh: 山西老乡，他一看见女朋友和别人说话就爱吃醋。
examples.en: He gets jealous whenever his girlfriend talks to someone else.

examples.zh: 你别山西老乡了，我只是同事而已。
examples.en: Don't get jealous; he's just a colleague.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Pun: 吃醋 literally 'eat vinegar' also means 'be jealous'; Shanxi is famed for vinegar.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。双关：“吃醋”指嫉妒；山西以醋闻名。

pinyin: shāi zi zhuāng shuǐ —— lòu dòng bǎi chū
literal: sieve · hold · water — leak · holes · hundred · emerge

meaning.zh: 筛子满是孔，装不住水，比喻说话做事破绽极多。

examples.zh: 他的说辞筛子装水，漏洞百出。
examples.en: His story is riddled with holes.

examples.zh: 这份方案筛子装水似的，不能通过。
examples.en: The plan is full of holes and can't pass.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. The punchline is the chengyu 漏洞百出.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。后半句即成语“漏洞百出”。

text: 南郭先生吹竽——滥竽充数
pinyin: nán guō xiān shēng chuī yú —— làn yú chōng shù
literal: Mr Nanguo · play · yu pipe — pass off · yu · make up · number
natural: Mr Nanguo playing the yu in the band

meaning.en: Passing oneself off as skilled to fill a place.
meaning.zh: 没本事的人混在行家里充数。

examples.zh: 南郭先生吹竽，他在团队里只是滥竽充数。
examples.en: He is just making up the numbers in the team.

examples.zh: 别让南郭先生吹竽的人混进来。
examples.en: Don't let impostors slip in.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. From the 《韩非子》 fable; punchline is the chengyu 滥竽充数.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。出自《韩非子》寓言；后半句即成语“滥竽充数”。

pinyin: liú bèi mài cǎo xié —— běn háng
literal: Liu Bei · sell · straw sandals — one's own · trade

meaning.en: Back at one's original trade; at home in the work.
meaning.zh: 刘备早年织席贩履，比喻干的是老本行。

examples.zh: 刘备卖草鞋，修车是他的本行。
examples.en: Repairing cars is his old trade.

examples.zh: 他又回去教书，真是刘备卖草鞋。
examples.en: He went back to teaching, his original line.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Liu Bei sold sandals and mats before rising to power.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。刘备早年以织席贩履为生。

pinyin: liáng shān bó de jūn shī —— wú (wú) yòng
natural: The strategist of Liangshan Marsh: Wu Yong

meaning.en: Useless (pun on the name 吴用 and 无用).
meaning.zh: 梁山军师名叫吴用，谐音“无用”。

examples.zh: 梁山泊的军师，你提的办法真是无用。
examples.en: Your suggestion is useless.

examples.zh: 他一点忙都帮不上，梁山泊的军师。
examples.en: He can't help at all, a real Wu Yong.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Pun: 吴用 (Wu Yong, the strategist in 《水浒传》) sounds like 无用 'useless'.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。双关：《水浒传》军师吴用谐音“无用”。

pinyin: liú bèi yù kǒng míng —— rú yú dé shuǐ
literal: Liu Bei · meet · Kongming — like · fish · get · water

meaning.en: Finding the perfect partner or setting.
meaning.zh: 刘备得诸葛亮辅佐，如鱼得水，比喻得到了合适的帮手或环境。

examples.zh: 刘备遇孔明，他找到新搭档后如鱼得水。
examples.en: With his new partner he is in his element.

examples.zh: 来到这家公司，他真像刘备遇孔明。
examples.en: At this company he has found his element.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Liu Bei said he found Kongming like a fish finding water (《三国志》).
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。刘备称得孔明如鱼得水（《三国志》）。

pinyin: lián pō bēi jīng tiáo —— fù jīng qǐng zuì
literal: Lian Po · carry · thorn rods — bear · thorns · beg · pardon
natural: Lian Po carrying thorn rods on his back

meaning.zh: 廉颇背着荆条向蔺相如谢罪，比喻诚恳认错。

examples.zh: 廉颇背荆条，他亲自上门道歉。
examples.en: He went in person to apologise humbly.

examples.zh: 错在我，我得廉颇背荆条去赔礼。
examples.en: I am in the wrong and must go and apologise.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. From Lian Po and Lin Xiangru in 《史记》.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。出自《史记》廉颇蔺相如故事。

text: 荆轲刺秦王——图穷匕首见
pinyin: jīng kē cì qín wáng —— tú qióng bǐ shǒu xiàn
literal: Jing Ke · stab · King of Qin — map · run out · dagger · appear
natural: Jing Ke stabbing the King of Qin

meaning.en: The real intent is revealed at the last moment.
meaning.zh: 荆轲献地图，地图展到尽头露出匕首，比喻最后露出真面目。

examples.zh: 荆轲刺秦王，谈判到最后图穷匕首见。
examples.en: At the end of the talks his true aim showed.

examples.zh: 他的好心原来是荆轲刺秦王。
examples.en: His kindness hid a real purpose.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. From 《史记·刺客列传》.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。出自《史记·刺客列传》。

text: 金漆马桶——外面光，里面臭
pinyin: jīn qī mǎ tǒng —— wài miàn guāng, lǐ miàn chòu
literal: gilded · chamber pot — outside · shiny, inside · stinking
natural: A gilded chamber pot: shiny outside, foul inside

meaning.en: Looks fine outside but is rotten within.
meaning.zh: 金漆马桶外表光鲜，内里肮脏，比喻徒有其表。

examples.zh: 金漆马桶，这家公司外面光，里面臭。
examples.en: The company looks good outside but is rotten within.

examples.zh: 别被他金漆马桶似的外表骗了。
examples.en: Don't be fooled by his shiny exterior.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Derogatory.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。含贬义。

pinyin: jiāng zǐ yá de zuò qí —— sì bù xiàng
literal: Jiang Ziya · 's · mount — four · not · resemble

meaning.zh: 姜子牙骑的神兽“四不像”，比喻不伦不类。

examples.zh: 姜子牙的坐骑，这个设计真是四不像。
examples.en: This design is neither fish nor fowl.

examples.zh: 他的风格姜子牙的坐骑，四不像。
examples.en: His style resembles nothing in particular.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. In 《封神演义》 Jiang Ziya rides a 四不像.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。《封神演义》中姜子牙骑四不像。

pinyin: huà tuó zhì bìng —— shǒu dào bìng chú
literal: Hua Tuo · cure · illness — hand · arrive · illness · vanish

meaning.en: Skilled work that solves a problem at once.
meaning.zh: 华佗医术高明，一出手病就好，比喻技艺高超、立即见效。

examples.zh: 华佗治病，老师傅修这台机器手到病除。
examples.en: The old master fixes this machine in no time.

examples.zh: 他真是华佗治病，手到病除。
examples.en: He cures it at a touch.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. The punchline is the chengyu 手到病除.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。后半句即成语“手到病除”。

text: 黑旋风的本名——理亏（李奎）
pinyin: hēi xuàn fēng de běn míng —— lǐ kuī (lǐ kuí)
literal: Black Whirlwind · 's · real name — in the wrong (Li Kui)
natural: The Black Whirlwind's real name: Li Kui

meaning.en: In the wrong (pun on 李逵 and 理亏).
meaning.zh: 黑旋风李逵，“李逵”谐音“理亏”。

equivalents: a pun on being at fault

examples.zh: 黑旋风的本名，这次是我理亏。
examples.en: This time I'm in the wrong.

examples.zh: 他知道自己黑旋风的本名，不敢争辩。
examples.en: He knew he was at fault and didn't argue.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Pun: 李逵 (Li Kui, nicknamed Black Whirlwind) sounds like 理亏 'in the wrong'.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。双关：“李逵”谐音“理亏”。

text: 海龙王的喽啰——虾兵蟹将
pinyin: hǎi lóng wáng de lóu luó —— xiā bīng xiè jiàng
literal: Sea Dragon King · 's · minions — shrimp · soldiers · crab · generals
natural: The Dragon King's minions: shrimp soldiers and crab generals

meaning.zh: 海龙王手下是虾兵蟹将，比喻无能的喽啰。

examples.zh: 海龙王的喽啰，他们不过是虾兵蟹将。
examples.en: They are mere small fry.

examples.zh: 海龙王的喽啰，对手只是虾兵蟹将，不足为惧。
examples.en: The opponents are small fry, nothing to fear.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. The punchline is the chengyu 虾兵蟹将.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。后半句即成语“虾兵蟹将”。

text: 苻坚望见八公山——草木皆兵
pinyin: fú jiān wàng jiàn bā gōng shān —— cǎo mù jiē bīng
literal: Fu Jian · gaze · Mount Bagong — grass · trees · all · soldiers
natural: Fu Jian gazing at Mount Bagong

meaning.en: Terror that makes everything look like an enemy.
meaning.zh: 苻坚兵败淝水，见八公山草木都像敌兵，比喻惊恐多疑。

examples.zh: 苻坚望见八公山，他最近草木皆兵。
examples.en: He has been jumpy lately, seeing enemies everywhere.

examples.zh: 苻坚望见八公山，一点风声就草木皆兵，没必要。
examples.en: No need to panic at the slightest rumour.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. From the Battle of Fei River (383).
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。典出淝水之战。
